_meta.units: art px, origin top-left of the 256x320 canvas (same registration as hideout.png)

floorDiamond.note: measured from floor pixels: front edges x-2y=-413 and x+2y=668; wall seams x+2y=487 (left) and x-2y=-232 (right)

drawOrder: decals (manhole, bowl, cushion) - floor level, under the pet
hideout-iso-front when pet is behind a prop (depthRule)
_meta.depthRule: iso box rule: for each prop, edgeY(x) = frontCorner.y - |x - frontCorner.x| / 2 (floor edges are 2:1). Pet is BEHIND the prop when pet feet y < edgeY(feet x) and the pet sprite overlaps the prop rect; then draw hideout-iso-front.png (or that prop's rect of it) above the pet. frontEdge is the measured bottom silhouette, for reference. Pet feet must stay inside 'floor' and outside every props[].footprint.
_meta.proposedTargets: bowl and cushion are separate decal sprites (v2); bed target = cushion centre (pet sits on it).
_meta.door: v2: door frame raised 16px (per-column stretch inside plain panel runs, string lights kept in front). Door ~95px (left post) to ~99px (right post) tall incl. frame = 1.48-1.55x a 64px pet.

labels.font: Departure Mono (decided), ~11-12pt mustard tag + dot connector

underground.scale: 4 device px per art px on 3x phones (1.333pt): 341x427pt
underground.spotlight: use the spotlight pool baked into underground.png; no code-drawn spotlight

auras.blaze: use fx/blaze-84-* (84px cell, feet anchor 42,74) instead of 98px

labelSide.manhole: below room (outside content bounds, matches mockup 'manhole · Underground')

interior.note: convex hull of the room's opaque pixels (= room silhouette). Clip auras/FX to this polygon or the 1-bit mask (same 256x320 registration).
